newsitem.title: USA: Dupont's Conoco buys Atlantic Energy stake.
newsitem.headline: Dupont's Conoco buys Atlantic Energy stake.

text.p: Conoco, a unit of DuPont Co, has purchased the 50 percent stake held in Atlantic Energy Inc by AmeriGas Partners LP, the companies said Thursday.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
AmeriGas said it sold it stake in Atlantic Energy after determining that it was not a "strategic asset."
Atlantic Energy's assets include a refrigerated liquified petroleum gas storage terminal with marine, truck and rail distribution facilities on the Elizabeth River in Chesapeake, Va.
Commonwealth Propane Inc, a unit of Columbia Gas System Inc, will retain its 50 percent ownership of Atlantic Energy and will also continue as operator of the terminal, Conoco said.
AmeriGas retails propane from 600 locations in 44 states. UGI Corp, through its subsidiaries, owns a 58 percent stake in the partnership. Individual unitholders own the remaining 42 percent.
